title: Prepare one bounded dense receipt per verified prefix
detail: An isolated native-preparation API produces one self-contained approved binary extent for its verified contiguous prefix. Received results borrow the same detached receipt buffer; the future native caller must write that buffer once with every admitted update. Its private live-physical mode keeps live expiry and every entry signature/open/chain/actor/tuple/current check. Received-only/floor checks remain. The bound codec performs all canonical structural checks. Per-entry legacy hex records are not built on this path. Actual byte/physical-row budgets count the page once; lower remaining budgets may narrow the extent and erase the unused result. Unselected entries grant no cursor or writing permission. A size refusal can keep only a previously verified prefix; a crypto refusal rejects the entire turn. A final expiry/current fence runs before transfer. No native caller is wired yet.
validation: Seven initial controls fail solely because the API is absent, with no matched app-defect credit. Nine final controls pass: four positions/one physical buffer/one parse/ten signature checks, interior cuts, two self-contained extents deliberately repeating original bytes, exact byte/row cuts, expired stored replay/live expiry, floor/raised-budget refusal, close after crypto, crypto refusal after a valid entry and final expiry. Development duplicate/missing imports and the reviewer’s AwaitExpression lookup error are retained and repaired without guard changes. Types,260focused cases across29files and18unchanged legacy pass. Independent normalized AST review preserves every old default/stored operation, entry loop, verifier invocation and cleanup. Quality, format,17registry checks, inventory and10controls pass. One runtime hash changes; no source-site/domain/construction/obligation moves. Latest full checkpoint remains412:323files/3161cases/one skip124.19s at240s.
summary: The new isolated preparation API shares one self-contained physical receipt across each verified prefix and retains live expiry, all entry checks and erasure. Nine controls and260focused/18legacy cases pass; old default/stored operations remain AST-exact.
limitations: Native writing remains unwired. No physical browser cold, activation, image, latency or RAM credit. Native framing/witness/atomic commit, dual audit, G8/B, floor lifecycle, old artifacts/cold/rollback and Stage5/6 remain. No format/trust/wire/default/limit/gate/deadline change, commit or deployment.
decisionTitle: Separate dense prefix preparation from native physical admission
decision: Prepare exact binary extents without granting native progress. Count the one receipt physically, every received position logically, and retain all cryptographic and lifetime guards. Only size scheduling may return an already verified prefix; cryptographic refusal returns none. The native owner must atomically commit all covered updates with exactly one receipt under its existing fresh floor/witness/authority fences.
next: Wire dense preparation into flagged grouped native receipt admission with explicit one-row framing and physical witness accounting, preserving every commit fence. Then dual audit, G8/B and floor/lifecycle/old artifacts/cold/rollback. Continue after the freeze.
